name: La Gata Blanca
source:
La gata blanca is a near-future story about a girl who wants to find a stable life in a quiet and scarcely populated island that faces an impending doom, unknown to its inhabitants; and a computer program that will do whatever it takes to preserve itself, with unforeseen consequences.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=42916/]Lemma Soft[/url]]
translation:
《La gata blanca》讲述了一个近未来的故事，讲述了一个女孩想要在一个安静且人烟稀少的岛屿上找到稳定的生活的故事，她面临着即将到来的厄运，而岛上的居民对此一无所知；以及一个会尽一切努力保护自身的计算机程序，但会带来不可预见的后果。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=42916/]Lemma Soft[/url]]
